result.topic_en: Struck-out notes on two hypotheses about the ether: in the first the mass contained in a fixed volume element stays constant; in the second, with vanishing velocity and derivative conditions at the boundary of a body, the motion is caused by the bodies. These lead into a heading on the explanation of light phenomena as a motion of the ether, with its listed properties.
